scope: Only current Roman Psalm appointments and the neighbouring complete source units required by their crossed boundaries; every other Psalm unit remains unavailable. Source89 and118 remain excluded.
method: Independent actual Syriac-body collation, explicitly inspected source lexical variants, and complete shifted-clause envelopes. Neither chapter counts, a blanket LXX offset nor a similarity threshold establishes an enabled edge. Frozen numeric rows are bound to source response/verse hashes. No witness wording, vocalization or missing clause is imported.

witness.credit: ETCBC Electronic Peshitta Text / Vetus Testamentum Syriace; comparison witness only, CC BY-NC text terms. No witness text is distributed.
witness.numbering: Hebrew-labelled Psalm body coordinates, with titles absent; bridged by the already pinned Original-to-STEP Standard correspondence.

exceptions.reason: ETCBC witness omits the works/justice and enduring clauses. Both complete source7-8 were additionally inspected against the primary published Psalm111:7-8.
